name: Mythic 3D figure renderer
purpose: Renders the 3D mythic figures (src/blender/mythic3d) in Blender, one figure per process under the host render lock, and lays out review sheets: a five-view turnaround per figure and look, and a gallery of hero shots.
capabilities: render --figures <ids|all> --look painted|bronze|both --views hero,front,q3,profile,q3back,back,head --opt figure:key=value --samples N --size WxH --tag name --out DIR
sheets: turnaround-<id>-<look>.png and gallery-<look>.png from the rendered views

installation.instructions: python scripts/mythic3d.py render. Needs Blender (python scripts/visual-director.py install-blender) and Pillow for the sheets.

compatibility.notes: Verified on Windows on 2026-11-25. Output goes to projects/_mythic-figures/3d/ (gitignored).

security.notes: Starts Blender in background mode with --factory-startup; writes renders, logs and job files under --out.

approval_evidence: 2026-11-25 Windows: rendered all eight figures in both looks; sheets built; tests/test-mythic3d.py.
